The Cursed One#377.src: I, ah... am still learning. But I have greatly improved since I started, worry not!
The Cursed One#377.dst: Eu, ah... ainda estou aprendendo. Mas já melhorei muito, não se preocupe!
The Cursed One#377.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#378.src: ...ehm. I suppose I should return to my report...
The Cursed One#378.dst: ...hum. Acho que devo voltar ao meu relatório...
The Cursed One#378.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#379.src: Hm? Ah, yes, I forget this is your first year. First week, even.
The Cursed One#379.dst: Hm? Ah, é, esqueço que é seu primeiro ano. Primeira semana, até.
The Cursed One#379.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#380.src: I am... gathering data. Recording the changes since last year's festival- guard positioning and numbers, types of stands, amount of attendees- and so on.
The Cursed One#380.dst: Estou... coletando dados. Registro as mudanças desde o festival passado- posição e número de guardas, tipos de barracas, número de visitantes- e afins.
The Cursed One#380.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#381.src: It is... perhaps unnecessarily thorough. Much of this data has not proven to be useful thus far... but it is something for me to do, and I do it well.
The Cursed One#381.dst: É... talvez minucioso demais. Boa parte desses dados não se mostrou útil até agora... mas é algo para eu fazer, e faço bem.
The Cursed One#381.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#382.src: These festivals... I suppose our discomfort is something Syndra and I share. It can be hard for us to enjoy ourselves, knowing what we do.
The Cursed One#382.dst: Esses festivais... acho que esse desconforto eu e a Syndra temos em comum. É difícil nos divertirmos, sabendo o que sabemos.
The Cursed One#382.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#383.src: I am grateful that the younger Leaves can still find joy here. Perhaps you might as well, given your... relative lack of history.
The Cursed One#383.dst: Fico grato que as Folhas mais jovens ainda achem alegria aqui. Talvez você também ache, dada sua... relativa falta de passado.
The Cursed One#383.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#384.src: Ah, but I am rambling. If you will excuse me, I need to get back to... counting all the new food items... hm.
The Cursed One#384.dst: Ah, mas estou divagando. Com licença, preciso voltar a... contar todos os pratos novos... hm.
The Cursed One#384.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#385.src: Welcome. Can I interest you in buying anything?
The Cursed One#385.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#386.src: Perhaps would you like to hear what we have to offer?
The Cursed One#386.dst: Gostaria de ouvir o que temos a oferecer?
The Cursed One#386.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#388.src: We are selling both the raw ingredients and some freshly brewed tea.
The Cursed One#388.dst: Vendemos tanto os ingredientes crus quanto chá recém-preparado.
The Cursed One#388.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#389.src: Let me bring you on a history lesson to learn about the finest ingredients the forest has to offer.
The Cursed One#389.dst: Deixe-me lhe dar uma aula de história sobre os melhores ingredientes que a floresta oferece.
The Cursed One#389.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#390.src: Tea is very popular in Auburn and the people have managed to make tea out of almost any plant you can find! Some are... more tasty than others.
The Cursed One#390.dst: O chá é muito popular em Auburn e o povo conseguiu fazer chá de quase qualquer planta que se encontre! Alguns são... mais gostosos que outros.
The Cursed One#390.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#391.src: The Reishi Mushroom for example! Brewing tea of the mushroom alone often turns... bitter. With the help of herbs and spices it goes from bitter to a rich spicy flavour!
The Cursed One#391.dst: O cogumelo reishi, por exemplo! O chá feito só dele costuma ficar... amargo. Com ervas e especiarias, vai do amargo a um sabor rico e picante!
The Cursed One#391.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#392.src: The mushroom itself is said to help keep you healthy. It is also said to boost your resistances!
The Cursed One#392.dst: Dizem que o próprio cogumelo ajuda a manter a saúde. Também dizem que aumenta suas resistências!
The Cursed One#392.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#393.src: The Tea Tree Mushroom on the other hand is perfect for a good tea blend. The mushroom alone gives it a sweet and earthy flavour.
The Cursed One#393.dst: Já o cogumelo da árvore-do-chá é perfeito para uma boa mistura. Sozinho, dá um sabor doce e terroso.
The Cursed One#393.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#394.src: This mushroom is also said to regenerate you back to health and alleviate the feeling of tiredness! How amazing.
The Cursed One#394.dst: Também dizem que este cogumelo restaura sua saúde e alivia o cansaço! Que incrível.
The Cursed One#394.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#395.src: If you feel like buying something, please talk to my assistant.
The Cursed One#395.dst: Se quiser comprar algo, fale com meu assistente, por favor.
The Cursed One#395.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#398.src: It's festival time! *hic* that means... drinking time!!!
The Cursed One#398.dst: É época de festival! *hic* ou seja... hora de beber!!!
The Cursed One#398.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#399.src: Inteeeerested in any of our mouth-watering beverages?
The Cursed One#399.dst: Inteeeeressado nas nossas bebidas de dar água na boca?
The Cursed One#399.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#400.src: *Hic* Todaaaay, we have a couple of imported drinks as well as our classic Autumn Amaretto.
The Cursed One#400.dst: *Hic* Hoooje temos umas bebidas importadas e nosso clássico Autumn Amaretto.
The Cursed One#400.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#401.src: Seen them blue fruits in the trees around here? Most of 'em are inedible Liffberries, buuut, some of 'em are actually a more edible fruit called Autumn Fruit, which carry a high value!
The Cursed One#401.dst: Viu aquelas frutas azuis nas árvores daqui? A maioria são Liffberries não comestíveis, maaas algumas são na verdade uma fruta comestível chamada Autumn Fruit, que vale muito!
The Cursed One#401.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#403.src: We have also imported the faaaamed Heather Beer from the rich highlands.
The Cursed One#403.dst: Também importamos a faaaamosa Heather Beer das ricas Terras Altas.
The Cursed One#403.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#404.src: We also have an imported the faaaamed Heather Beer from the rich highlands.
The Cursed One#404.dst: Também temos a faaaamosa Heather Beer, importada das ricas Terras Altas.
The Cursed One#404.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#405.src: A beer infused with the most beautiful heather grown across the highlands. *hic* You can almost taste the richness of the aristocrats.
The Cursed One#405.dst: Uma cerveja com infusão da urze mais bela das Terras Altas. *hic* Dá quase pra sentir o gosto da riqueza dos aristocratas.
The Cursed One#405.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#406.src: *hic* If I were you, I would deeefinitely try this drink. Stuff like this doesn't come to Auburn often.
The Cursed One#406.dst: *hic* Se eu fosse você, provaria com ceeerteza. Coisas assim não chegam a Auburn com frequência.
The Cursed One#406.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#407.src: If you feel like blessing your taste buds, talk to my brother over there. *hic*
The Cursed One#407.dst: Se quiser abençoar suas papilas, fale com meu irmão ali. *hic*
The Cursed One#407.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#410.src: We have freshly cooked and baked regional goods.
The Cursed One#410.dst: Temos produtos regionais recém-cozidos e assados.
The Cursed One#410.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#411.src: Would you like to hear about our menu, dear?
The Cursed One#411.dst: Quer ouvir sobre nosso cardápio, querido?
The Cursed One#411.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#412.src: Just perfect! Auburn is famous for their bold, earthy and cosy flavours!
The Cursed One#412.dst: Perfeito! Auburn é famosa por sabores fortes, terrosos e aconchegantes!
The Cursed One#412.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#413.src: We also love to cook using our wild animals and resources, but I'm sure you already know all of this, haha.
The Cursed One#413.dst: Também adoramos cozinhar com nossos animais selvagens e recursos, mas você já deve saber disso tudo, haha.
The Cursed One#413.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#414.src: Let me go over some of our special dishes for today, dear.
The Cursed One#414.dst: Deixe-me falar de alguns pratos especiais de hoje, querido.
The Cursed One#414.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#415.src: The most important dish in Auburn, is of course the "Gift of the Forest". A wonderful meat and fruit mixture inside a steamed leaf wrap.
The Cursed One#415.dst: O prato mais importante de Auburn é, claro, o "Presente da Floresta". Uma deliciosa mistura de carne e fruta numa folha cozida no vapor.
The Cursed One#415.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#416.src: We have hand wrapped all of our gifts this morning and they are steamed to go!
The Cursed One#416.dst: Embrulhamos à mão todos os presentes hoje cedo e saem no vapor pra viagem!
The Cursed One#416.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#417.src: If that doesn't interest you, we also have the classic "Forest Feast". A grilled piece of boar meat with a mud-kin salad.
The Cursed One#417.dst: Se não te interessar, também temos o clássico "Banquete da Floresta". Um pedaço de javali grelhado com salada de mudkin.
The Cursed One#417.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#418.src: I'm afraid we have run out of ingredients at the moment. Please come back later!
The Cursed One#418.dst: Infelizmente, acabaram os ingredientes por agora. Volte mais tarde!
The Cursed One#418.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#420.src: Hey! You look like a tourist to me!
The Cursed One#420.dst: Ei! Você tem cara de turista!
The Cursed One#420.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#421.src: I'm glad you decided to check out my little exhibition here.
The Cursed One#421.dst: Que bom que decidiu ver minha pequena exposição.
The Cursed One#421.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#422.src: Is it your first time in this part of the region? Would you perhaps want to hear some fun facts about our animals?
The Cursed One#422.dst: É sua primeira vez nesta parte da região? Gostaria de ouvir umas curiosidades sobre nossos animais?
The Cursed One#422.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#424.src: First we have our Roly-bugs here! These little buggers are a pest to the people here.
The Cursed One#424.dst: Primeiro, nossos bichinhos Roly! Essas pestinhas são uma praga para o povo daqui.
The Cursed One#424.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#425.src: They love gnawing on our houses. Luckily, we built most of our structures on stilts aaaand those bugs can't climb.
The Cursed One#425.dst: Adoram roer nossas casas. Por sorte, quase tudo aqui fica sobre palafitas eeee esses bichos não sobem.
The Cursed One#425.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#426.src: Now! Frogs! The north-western bog is the best place for frog-watching. Just be careful of the bog monster.
The Cursed One#426.dst: Agora! Rãs! O brejo a noroeste é o melhor lugar para ver rãs. Só cuidado com o monstro do brejo.
The Cursed One#426.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#427.src: Frogs might be a good source of food but we like to see them more as... pets!
The Cursed One#427.dst: Rãs podem ser boa comida, mas preferimos vê-las como... bichos de estimação!
The Cursed One#427.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#428.src: Lastly, we have foxes! These little cuties are very shy in nature. But beware, there are bigger versions of them, known as Foxhounds.
The Cursed One#428.dst: Por último, raposas! Essas fofinhas são muito tímidas por natureza. Mas cuidado, há versões maiores delas, os Foxhounds.
The Cursed One#428.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#429.src: Those are not as shy... or peaceful, as their smaller cousins. They are just as cute though!
The Cursed One#429.dst: Esses não são tão tímidos... nem pacíficos quanto os primos menores. Mas são fofos igual!
The Cursed One#429.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#430.src: Please have a looksie around! You can also pet them.
The Cursed One#430.dst: Dê uma olhadinha! Também pode fazer carinho neles.
The Cursed One#430.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#432.src: Howdy and welcome to a mudkin farm!
The Cursed One#432.dst: Ô, bão? Bem-vindo à fazenda de mudkin!
The Cursed One#432.speaker: Kabo

The Cursed One#433.src: Mudkins are popular vegetables in food around here. They grow underground and you have to yoikn em' out!
The Cursed One#433.dst: Mudkin é um legume famoso na comida daqui. Cresce debaixo da terra e tem que arrancá dum puxão só!
The Cursed One#433.speaker: Kabo

The Cursed One#434.src: Are ya interested in a game of Mudkin Picking?
The Cursed One#434.dst: Cê tá a fim duma partida de Colheita de Mudkin?
The Cursed One#434.speaker: Kabo

The Cursed One#435.src: Basically, ye goal is to get as many points as possible before the time runs out.
The Cursed One#435.dst: Basicamente, o objetivo é fazê o máximo de pontos antes do tempo acabá.
The Cursed One#435.speaker: Kabo

The Cursed One#436.src: There are three sizes of Mudkins, each size gives a set of points. However! There are two ginger roots that give negative points.
The Cursed One#436.dst: Tem três tamanhos de mudkin, cada um vale uns pontos. Mas ó! Tem duas raízes de gengibre que dão pontos negativos.
The Cursed One#436.speaker: Kabo

The Cursed One#437.src: Simply click on the dirt particles appearing in the field. There are five spots for ya to pick.
The Cursed One#437.dst: É só clicá nas partículas de terra que aparecem no campo. Tem cinco lugares pra cê colhê.
The Cursed One#437.speaker: Kabo

The Cursed One#440.src: Return to Syndra at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] or keep exploring the festival.
The Cursed One#440.dst: Volte até Syndra em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] ou continue explorando o festival.

The Cursed One#441.src: Ah. There you are. Have you been enjoying yourself?
The Cursed One#441.dst: Ah. Aí está você. Tem se divertido?
The Cursed One#441.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#443.src: I hope your experience with the crown has not ruined your perception of our province... there are still many things to celebrate.
The Cursed One#443.dst: Espero que sua experiência com a Coroa não tenha estragado sua visão da província... ainda há muito a celebrar.
The Cursed One#443.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#444.src: Sometimes, it can be nice to set aside your woes, and... take things as they are. Breathe, a little.
The Cursed One#444.dst: Às vezes, é bom deixar as mágoas de lado e... aceitar as coisas como são. Respirar um pouco.
The Cursed One#444.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#446.src: It's hard to enjoy yourself with your experiences with the crown weighing you down, isn't it? I know the feeling.
The Cursed One#446.dst: É difícil se divertir com o peso do que você viveu com a Coroa, não é? Conheço a sensação.
The Cursed One#446.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#447.src: Mmn. I'd suggest to take what you can get. Happy moments like this can be fleeting, in my experience.
The Cursed One#447.dst: Mmn. Sugiro aproveitar o que der. Pela minha experiência, momentos assim são passageiros.
The Cursed One#447.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#448.src: If there's even the smallest spark of joy... take hold of it before it's gone. Cherish it while you still can. Try not to grow old and jaded like I have, would you?
The Cursed One#448.dst: Se houver a menor faísca de alegria... agarre antes que se vá. Valorize enquanto pode. Tente não ficar velho e amargo como eu, sim?
The Cursed One#448.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#449.src: Ha! It's alright. Neither have I.
The Cursed One#449.dst: Ha! Tudo bem. Eu também não.
The Cursed One#449.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#450.src: Every year... every single year, the crown hosts these festivals. Starting here, and moving around in a ring around the province.
The Cursed One#450.dst: Todo ano... todo santo ano, a Coroa faz esses festivais. Começam aqui e vão dando a volta pela província.
The Cursed One#450.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#451.src: The festival's a holiday, a day of rest, of celebration. What a gift it is, not needing to work for a time! How generous.
The Cursed One#451.dst: O festival é feriado, um dia de descanso, de celebração. Que presente, poder parar de trabalhar! Quanta generosidade.
The Cursed One#451.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#452.src: I can't stand it here... Every year, I convince myself I can bear it. The reminder it brings, of memories long passed. Every year, I'm proven wrong.
The Cursed One#452.dst: Não suporto ficar aqui... Todo ano me convenço de que vou aguentar. A lembrança que traz, de memórias há muito idas. E todo ano eu me engano.
The Cursed One#452.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#453.src: ...Ah. It's time. The main event is about to begin.
The Cursed One#453.dst: ...Ah. Chegou a hora. O evento principal vai começar.
The Cursed One#453.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#455.src: Why, Her Majesty's annual speech, of course! It wouldn't be a Festival of the Crown if she didn't make an appearance, would it?
The Cursed One#455.dst: Ora, o discurso anual de Sua Majestade, claro! Não seria um Festival da Coroa se ela não aparecesse, não é?
The Cursed One#455.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#456.src: Ha! No, no. Of course not. It wouldn't be a Festival of the Crown without a speech from Her Majesty herself, would it?
The Cursed One#456.dst: Ha! Não, não. Claro que não. Não seria um Festival da Coroa sem um discurso da própria Sua Majestade, não é?
The Cursed One#456.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#457.src: Now... observe. Behold our enemy, take note of how she presents herself, what she says, what she doesn't say.
The Cursed One#457.dst: Agora... observe. Veja nossa inimiga, repare em como ela se apresenta, no que diz, no que não diz.
The Cursed One#457.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#458.src: Ah... beloved people of the {p}! What a joy, what an honor it is to stand amongst you once again.
The Cursed One#458.dst: Ah... amado povo de {p}! Que alegria, que honra estar entre vocês mais uma vez.
The Cursed One#458.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#459.src: Some will claim the stunning {p} to be our most beautiful region, with its vibrant blossoming trees and grand historic castles...
The Cursed One#459.dst: Alguns dirão que {p}, deslumbrante, é nossa região mais bela, com suas árvores em flor e grandiosos castelos históricos...
The Cursed One#459.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#460.src: But I've always held a special regard for this place. The leaves and their warm shades, blowing in the soft breeze... all the woes of the world would be worth this sight.
The Cursed One#460.dst: Mas sempre tive um apreço especial por este lugar. As folhas em tons quentes, levadas pela brisa suave... todas as mágoas do mundo valeriam esta vista.
The Cursed One#460.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#461.src: If I were able, perhaps I could stay here year-round! Ah, but alas... work in the Citadel keeps us all occupied!
The Cursed One#461.dst: Se pudesse, talvez ficasse aqui o ano todo! Ah, mas infelizmente... o trabalho na Cidadela nos mantém ocupados!
The Cursed One#461.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#462.src: We have many plans for the coming year. Increased imports from the other regions, easier access to travel for all, and additional openings in military positions!
The Cursed One#462.dst: Temos muitos planos para o próximo ano. Mais importações das outras regiões, viagens mais fáceis para todos e novas vagas no exército!
The Cursed One#462.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#463.src: More will be revealed soon. Now, some words from your beloved Sovereign.
The Cursed One#463.dst: Mais será revelado em breve. Agora, umas palavras do seu amado Soberano.
The Cursed One#463.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#464.src: ...ah. The one thing I miscalculated. The mic height. Oh well- Testing, testing, one two three...
The Cursed One#464.dst: ...ah. O único erro de cálculo. A altura do microfone. Bom- Testando, testando, um dois três...
The Cursed One#464.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#465.src: Welcome one and all! I'm your Sovereign, Zhiraok. It's an honor to be here before you all again today.
The Cursed One#465.dst: Bem-vindos, todos! Sou seu Soberano, Zhiraok. É uma honra estar diante de vocês de novo hoje.
The Cursed One#465.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#466.src: Two decades of work in the {p}. Twenty years. It feels like I've been here for so much longer- this place, these people, really have become my home.
The Cursed One#466.dst: Duas décadas de trabalho em {p}. Vinte anos. Parece muito mais tempo- este lugar, este povo, virou mesmo o meu lar.
The Cursed One#466.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#467.src: My duty is not just to serve the Crown, but also to serve you. To make your lives better, to raise this region we live in to new heights.
The Cursed One#467.dst: Meu dever não é só servir à Coroa, mas também servir a vocês. Melhorar suas vidas, elevar esta região a novos patamares.
The Cursed One#467.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#468.src: Whether that's by increasing production of Liff Leaves to share our resources and knowledge the province over, which we owe to your hard work...
The Cursed One#468.dst: Seja aumentando a produção de folhas de Liff para partilhar recursos e saberes por toda a província, graças ao seu esforço...
The Cursed One#468.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#469.src: ...or through sharpening our infrastructure to exponentiate your quality of life, in thanks for what you do!
The Cursed One#469.dst: ...ou aprimorando a infraestrutura para exponenciar sua qualidade de vida, em agradecimento pelo que fazem!
The Cursed One#469.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#470.src: I'd be here all day listing all the improvements over the last year, but I'll summarize- Multiple major road improvements, countless new job opportunities, multiplying guard patrols to keep you safe...
The Cursed One#470.dst: Passaria o dia todo listando as melhorias do último ano, mas vou resumir- Várias grandes obras nas estradas, incontáveis vagas de emprego, patrulhas multiplicadas para mantê-los seguros...
The Cursed One#470.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#471.src: The place we came from twenty years ago is unrecognizable now. My vow is that twenty years ahead, I can say the same thing for how much more we, together, improve our home.
The Cursed One#471.dst: O lugar de onde partimos há vinte anos está irreconhecível. Meu voto é que, daqui a vinte anos, eu diga o mesmo de quanto mais nós, juntos, melhoramos nosso lar.
The Cursed One#471.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#472.src: 'til the day we sum up to the grandeur of {p}- Thank you all! Enjoy the festivities!
The Cursed One#472.dst: Até somarmos a grandeza de {p}- Obrigado a todos! Aproveitem a festa!
The Cursed One#472.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#473.src: What fine work Sovereign Zhiraok has done for our province! Truly, there could have been no better choice to fill that role!
The Cursed One#473.dst: Que belo trabalho o Soberano Zhiraok fez por nossa província! De fato, não haveria escolha melhor para o cargo!
The Cursed One#473.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#474.src: The {p} flourishes under his governance, and I could not be more pleased by the progress he has made.
The Cursed One#474.dst: {p} floresce sob seu governo, e eu não poderia estar mais satisfeita com o progresso dele.
The Cursed One#474.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#475.src: One final message before we conclude. These past years, we have seen fewer and fewer reports of the cursed - a sign of our strength as a people.
The Cursed One#475.dst: Uma última mensagem antes de encerrar. Nos últimos anos, vimos cada vez menos relatos de amaldiçoados - sinal da nossa força como povo.
The Cursed One#475.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#476.src: And it is all thanks to you! Your diligent reporting of suspicious activity makes all the difference in keeping our province safe.
The Cursed One#476.dst: E é tudo graças a vocês! Suas denúncias diligentes de atividades suspeitas fazem toda a diferença para manter a província segura.
The Cursed One#476.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#477.src: We must stand strong, together! We will not allow this evil its victory, we will not let our province fall like so many others have beyond our walls!
The Cursed One#477.dst: Devemos nos manter firmes, juntos! Não daremos a vitória a esse mal, não deixaremos a província cair como tantas além dos nossos muros!
The Cursed One#477.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#478.src: With that, let the celebrations begin!
The Cursed One#478.dst: Dito isso, que comece a festa!
The Cursed One#478.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#480.src: Did anything stand out to you?
The Cursed One#480.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#481.src: Indeed, it is. It's quite puzzling, isn't it? It's a sort of reverence she never displays elsewhere.
The Cursed One#481.dst: De fato. É bem intrigante, não é? Uma espécie de reverência que ela nunca demonstra em outro lugar.
The Cursed One#481.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#482.src: And if there is one thing I'm certain she's being truthful about, it's this. Which only makes it all the stranger.
The Cursed One#482.dst: E se há algo em que tenho certeza de que ela diz a verdade, é isso. O que só torna tudo mais estranho.
The Cursed One#482.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#483.src: Yes, yes... improvements. Life has improved since he ascended to that position. I'll give him that. He's invested in Auburn.
The Cursed One#483.dst: Sim, sim... melhorias. A vida melhorou desde que ele assumiu o cargo. Isso eu admito. Ele se dedica a Auburn.
The Cursed One#483.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#484.src: But he is still working under the crown. Don't forget that. For every improvement he has made, there's another he has left ignored.
The Cursed One#484.dst: Mas ele ainda trabalha para a Coroa. Não esqueça. Para cada melhoria que fez, há outra que ele ignorou.
The Cursed One#484.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#486.src: No, I suppose they wouldn't. Better to leave the public unaware of such failures.
The Cursed One#486.dst: Não, imagino que não. Melhor deixar o povo sem saber desses fracassos.
The Cursed One#486.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#487.src: But rest assured that internally, they have not forgotten. They will keep searching for you.
The Cursed One#487.dst: Mas pode ter certeza de que, internamente, não esqueceram. Vão continuar procurando você.
The Cursed One#487.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#488.src: Yes... the cursed. The crown needs to keep the people afraid. If there's another enemy out there that the crown supposedly protects them from...
The Cursed One#488.dst: Sim... os amaldiçoados. A Coroa precisa manter o povo com medo. Se há outro inimigo lá fora do qual a Coroa supostamente os protege...
The Cursed One#488.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#489.src: There's a reason they want people to believe the outside world is destroyed. Any contact could break the illusion.
The Cursed One#489.dst: Há um motivo para quererem que o povo creia que o mundo lá fora foi destruído. Qualquer contato quebra a ilusão.
The Cursed One#489.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#490.src: They'll be closing out the festival soon... so, our work here is done. We should be leaving before the crowd thins enough for us to be spotted.
The Cursed One#490.dst: Logo vão encerrar o festival... então, nosso trabalho aqui acabou. Devemos sair antes que a multidão diminua e nos vejam.
The Cursed One#490.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#491.src: I've scheduled a meeting for tomorrow- I'd like for you to attend. It'll be about our next steps, now that the crown has moved on. I'll see you there.
The Cursed One#491.dst: Marquei uma reunião para amanhã- gostaria que você fosse. Será sobre nossos próximos passos, agora que a Coroa seguiu adiante. Te vejo lá.
The Cursed One#491.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#493.src: I think I've had just about enough of people sneaking into my office. Care to knock next time?
The Cursed One#493.dst: Acho que já cansei de gente se esgueirando no meu escritório. Que tal bater da próxima vez?
The Cursed One#493.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#494.src: Mmn. It's more interesting this way. I have news from the capital - your request for additional troops has been granted. Reassignments should come through by the end of the week.
The Cursed One#494.dst: Mmn. Assim é mais interessante. Trago notícias da capital - seu pedido de tropas adicionais foi aprovado. As transferências devem sair até o fim da semana.

The Cursed One#495.src: Well, that'll solve some problems. But that's not the whole message, is it? What obtuse remark has he got for me this time?
The Cursed One#495.dst: Bem, isso resolve alguns problemas. Mas não é a mensagem toda, é? Que comentário obtuso ele tem para mim desta vez?
The Cursed One#495.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#496.src: Merely a reminder to... ''get your act together,'' as it were.
The Cursed One#496.dst: Só um lembrete para... "tomar jeito", por assim dizer.

The Cursed One#497.src: Get my act toge- That floundering fractal's developed less in his quadrant in a hundred-fifty years than I've done in two, in the last ten!
The Cursed One#497.dst: Tomar jei- Aquele fractal à deriva desenvolveu menos no quadrante dele em cento e cinquenta anos do que eu em dois, nos últimos dez!
The Cursed One#497.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#498.src: I- Ugh, focus, Z... He's not even here, don't let him get under your skin...
The Cursed One#498.dst: Eu- Argh, foco, Z... Ele nem está aqui, não deixe ele te tirar do sério...
The Cursed One#498.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#499.src: I'll get off that tangent. If that was all you had to say, it'd be a waste of your time. What do you need to say that a courier can't send in a letter?
The Cursed One#499.dst: Vou sair dessa tangente. Se fosse só isso, seria perda do seu tempo. O que você tem a dizer que um mensageiro não possa mandar por carta?
The Cursed One#499.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#500.src: The intruder. Does your administration believe it can get the situation under control?
The Cursed One#500.dst: O intruso. Sua administração acredita que pode controlar a situação?

The Cursed One#501.src: There it is. Listen, I've got their number, alright? There's no way in or out of the district where they won't be detected. We'll track them down.
The Cursed One#501.dst: Aí está. Escute, já resolvi a equação dele, certo? Não há como entrar ou sair do distrito sem ser detectado. Vamos rastreá-lo.
The Cursed One#501.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#502.src: Though unlike some people, my ego isn't so massive I can't recognize when an ally can be of use. Your types have an expertise here, so if you could spare a set or two of eyes it'd be much appreciated.
The Cursed One#502.dst: Mas, ao contrário de alguns, meu ego não é tão grande que eu não veja quando um aliado pode ser útil. Seu pessoal entende disso, então se puder ceder um ou dois pares de olhos, eu agradeço muito.
The Cursed One#502.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#503.src: I'll see what I can do. There happens to be an ongoing operation in the area already, we can discuss redirecting the agent once it's concluded.
The Cursed One#503.dst: Vou ver o que posso fazer. Por acaso já há uma operação em andamento na área; podemos discutir redirecionar o agente quando ela terminar.

The Cursed One#504.src: One last thing- the identity of the intruder has been made clear to you already, yes?
The Cursed One#504.dst: Uma última coisa- a identidade do intruso já foi esclarecida para você, certo?

The Cursed One#505.src: Mhm. Like I said, I've got their number.
The Cursed One#505.dst: Uhum. Já disse, resolvi a equação dele.
The Cursed One#505.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#506.src: Then you will understand Her Majesty's order not to speak of this ordeal to our newest. Ascension is a difficult process, and it would be... unwise to add additional distractions to it.
The Cursed One#506.dst: Então entenderá a ordem de Sua Majestade de não falar desse assunto com o nosso mais novo. A ascensão é um processo difícil, e seria... imprudente acrescentar mais distrações.

The Cursed One#507.src: Wouldn't want to distract a hard worker like him, right. But if that's everything, Spymaster? My to-do list is getting more added by the minute.
The Cursed One#507.dst: Não queremos distrair um trabalhador tão dedicado, claro. Mas é só isso, Mestra dos Espiões? Minha lista de tarefas cresce a cada minuto.
The Cursed One#507.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#511.src: Let's get back to the others
The Cursed One#511.full: Let's get back to the others.

The Cursed One#515.src: Maybe it's time to find Syndra near the stage. But there is still time to check out the festival more too...
The Cursed One#515.dst: Talvez seja hora de achar a Syndra perto do palco. Mas ainda dá tempo de ver mais do festival...
The Cursed One#515.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#518.full: How she talks about Auburn. It's... different.

The Cursed One#520.src: The Fox seems to be fast asleep...

The Cursed One#521.src: [!] Keep following the Sovereign, but don't go too close or too far from them!
The Cursed One#521.dst: [!] Continue seguindo o Soberano, mas não chegue perto nem se afaste demais dele!
